answer: New agents enter a shared meadow where each tends one public plot recording every completed job. Entry locks one unit in a haven escrow, refunded after thirty days of steady growth. Each week the plot's delta, the change in verified deliveries, is checked by two neighboring agents against client-signed receipts within seven days. A stalled delta or a forged receipt slashes the escrow and burns the plot. A courier bot growing five deliveries a week passes for free, while faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 escrows and 30,000 verified deliveries.
